product_metadata.title: Vivimee Glass Coffee Mugs Set of 4, Clear Coffee Mug 15 Oz, Large Glass Mugs With Handles for Hot Beverages, Clear Mugs for Tea, Cappuccino, Latte, Espresso Coffee, Juice, Glass Coffee Cups
features: THE PERFECT SIZE – Enjoy your coffee and tea in these modern and elegant 16 oz large coffee mugs. Standing at 4.5" tall, these glass cups are perfect for hot or cold drinks: tea, coffee, latte, espresso, cappuccino, macchiato, demitasse, smoothie and juice, also great as container for dessert, cake, mousse, lemon drink, beer,kombucha and sangria, the clear mugs set of 6 are used for a family party or to entertain your guests.

SAFE FIRST – These clear glass coffee cups are made from heat-resistant and scratch free borosilicate, lead free, non-toxic and tasteless, the glass mugs of this material are stronger and more durable than common glass meanwihle giving a smooth finish and a crystal clear look. The 6 Piece Coffee Mug Set have a nice feel in your hand and are amazingly durable and suitable for everyday use.

EASY TO HOLD – The Vivimee clear tea cup with big handle are easy for you to wrap 2-3 fingers around it, also they can keep coffee glass from rotating when you try to hold the mug, which helps you enjoy your tea/coffee comfortably. And the convenient handles always stay cool to the touch even when drinks are reheated in the mug.

MICROWAVE & DISHWASHER SAFE – Our clear mugs for hot beverage can withstand a temperature of up to 485 Fahrenheit, allowing you to heat up your beverage to a desired temperature in the microwave, also wash away drink residue easily by handwashing the glass mugs with soap and warm water, or conveniently clean it (hands free) in the dishwasher.
BUY WITH CONFIDENCE – The 24/7 support will be provided towards giving our customers the high-quality Vivimee coffee mugs with high-quality packaging.
